title: Open an Engram test runner on Windows B so Engram Windows FULLs can leave Central
outcome: Open an Engram test runner on Windows B so Engram Windows FULLs can leave Central
acceptance: A TermAl native "Engram runner" session exists on Windows B with one Engram clone (for example C:\github\Personal\Engram-runner) whose push URL is disabled; it installs no Engram binary, opens no store and restarts nothing; its session name, path and HEAD are recorded here

One Engram Windows FULL runs there from a bundle or author-test ref of an exact candidate in a fresh worktree with the launcher's source_id equality, and its run id and result are recorded here; memory dl560-runner-checklist lists the Windows B Engram lane
